summary: East kerb on a quiet street, bottom end; homes 20 m or more away.
reasons: Grass verge, a car parks here

best_section.where: Bottom end of the east kerb, where Tenth Avenue bends, before it climbs

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 20-28 m on this side; one house 8 m away further up at 22 m. Wooded backdrop to the south-east.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with a grass and dirt verge on the east side wide enough to pull onto.
drivers.convention: A car is parked on the verge, but signs are 2P resident permit Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep: about 5% at the best section, up to 18% above
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy to the south and east; shaded mornings.
